# Draft:Electrical CAD/CAE Software

----
Electrical CAD Software
Electrical CAD (Computer-Aided Design) software refers to specialized computer programs used for designing electrical systems and circuits. These tools assist engineers, designers, and technicians in creating detailed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and other technical documentation required for electrical installations and automation systems.
Overview
Electrical CAD software automates and streamlines the design process for electrical control systems, enabling precise creation and modification of electrical schematics and documentation. Features typically include symbol libraries, automatic wire numbering, component cross-referencing, bill of materials (BOM) generation, and error checking.
The software supports compliance with various international electrical standards such as IEC, ANSI, DIN, and NFPA, which helps ensure designs meet safety and regulatory requirements.
Applications
Electrical CAD software is widely used in industries such as:
* Industrial automation and control systems
* Machinery and equipment manufacturing
* Electrical panel building and switchgear design
* Building automation and infrastructure
* Energy and power distribution
It is utilized by electrical engineers, system integrators, OEMs (original equipment manufacturers), control panel builders, and maintenance teams for efficient and accurate design and documentation.
Types of Electrical CAD Software
Electrical CAD software varies in complexity and specialization. Some focus on schematic capture, while others provide integrated solutions including panel layout, 3D cabinet design, and wire harness design. Popular features include:
* Schematic drawing and editing
* Automated wire and cable numbering
* Component tagging and cross-referencing
* Bill of materials and parts list generation
* Integration with mechanical CAD (MCAD) systems
* Simulation and validation tools
Notable Software Examples
Some widely known electrical CAD software products include:
* AutoCAD Electrical
* EPLAN Electric P8
* Zuken E3.series
* Cofaso
* SolidWorks Electrical
* WSCAD
* SEE Electrical
